response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), ranked AS (SELECT city_id, address_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY address_count DESC) AS city_rank FROM city_counts) SELECT city_id, address_count, CAST(address_count AS DECIMAL(30,20)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction FROM ranked WHERE city_rank <= 10 ORDER BY address_count DESC, city_id;
